title: An exhausted subscription is not capacity (#858)

story.i_want_to: a runner that declares its subscription exhausted to receive no work until its reset
story.so_that: dispatches stop burning slots on machines that cannot start a session, and the operator sees when capacity returns

rationale: Eligibility checks draining, repo and kind; the scarce resource is the subscription window, which nothing sees. A declared, clamped, persisted reset keeps exhausted machines out of every placement path without trusting an arbitrary timestamp, and runners on one account are exhausted and cleared together.

acceptance_criteria.description: The status message accepts optional usage {exhausted, resets_at, account_ref}; a malformed usage object is refused invalid_payload.
exhausted: true stores usage_exhausted_until on the runners row, clamped to between now + 60s and now + 8 days.
exhausted: true without resets_at stores now + 8 days.
A session_ended usage_exhausted stores usage_exhausted_until = now + 8 days for that runner unless a later reset is already stored.
A runner is exhausted while its own or any same-tenant same-account_ref row has usage_exhausted_until in the future.
An exhausted runner is refused by Runners.accepts?/5 and by Placement.place/4 with runner_exhausted.
exhausted: false clears usage_exhausted_until on every row in the tenant with that account_ref.
runner_pool shows usage_exhausted_until per runner, and the driver's no_runner log names the earliest reset.

test_cases.name: far reset is clamped
steps: push exhausted with resets_at 30 days out

test_cases.name: session_ended marks exhaustion
preconditions: story at implementing on runner r

test_cases.name: exhausted account excluded everywhere
preconditions: runners r1, r2 with account_ref 'a'; r1 exhausted
steps: run the driver; call Placement.place on r2
expected_results: driver places nothing; place returns runner_exhausted

test_cases.name: pool and log show the reset
preconditions: one exhausted runner, one queued story
expected_results: pool row carries usage_exhausted_until; log names it

test_cases.name: tenant isolation
steps: tenant A driver with its own runner on account_ref 'a'

technical_notes: Columns on runners: usage_exhausted_until utc_datetime, account_ref string (migration; set programmatically)
Eligibility: Runners.accepts?/5 (runners.ex:903) for driver and triage; Placement.place/4 checks runner_accepting_work (placement.ex:441-443) and needs the same check
Contract: usage on the status message (1.15.0); a runner not sending it is unaffected
Status messages are rate-limited to one per second per runner: tests use separate runners or separate tests rather than two back-to-back pushes
non_goals: Does not schedule a wakeup at the reset time
